description:
Toggle the account-wide emergency spend freeze across the master key and every delegated subagent key simultaneously. Use this to halt all spending during an incident or isolate a compromised root master key; do not use to permanently disable individual subagents (x402_revoke_delegate_key).
Parameters: frozen=true records reason (default "operator_freeze"), whereas frozen=false clears frozen_reason; supply master spend_key or header (conflicting values return HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge, idempotent target state; frozen accounts block paid calls with HTTP 403 account_frozen while read/audit tools stay active; returns HTTP 403 for delegates and HTTP 401 invalid key.

frozen.description: Set true to immediately halt all master and subagent spends across the account, or false to lift the freeze and resume spending.

reason.description: Optional incident or operator audit reason recorded on the account freeze state (e.g. "anomaly_investigation").

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_set_account_freeze

frozen.description: Active emergency freeze flag after this operation.

ok.description: True when the account freeze state was updated.

title: Set Account Emergency Freeze
